2026_01_MIA_LV.headline: Las Vegas loses Bowers but can redirect the offense through a healthy backfield
2026_01_MIA_LV.paragraph1: The Raiders ruled Brock Bowers out after his knee procedure, while Ashton Jeanty carries no game designation and the Dolphins enter without an injury designation. Miami has the cleaner health profile, so Las Vegas cannot rely on personnel superiority. The Raiders’ answer is to shift the offensive burden toward the run game, condensed formations and play-action, making Miami commit bodies before attacking vacated space. The Dolphins can flip that script by winning first down and forcing a Bowers-less passing game into obvious dropback situations.
2026_01_MIA_LV.model_rationale: Las Vegas can survive the missing tight end if its run structure creates efficient play-action opportunities and prevents Miami from turning the game into obvious dropback football.
